## Checklist

- [ ] Scope is a single feature; size is justified if over about 500 lines
- [ ] Loading, empty, and error states are handled
- [ ] Forms keep input on failure and block double submission
- [ ] Keyboard navigation works and inputs have labels
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `docs/lld.md` updated if a contract changed
- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] Labels: `enhancement`, one `v1-*` area, priority
